description.0: The sum count of unique addresses that were active in the network (either as a recipient or originator of a ledger change) in the trailing 30 days up to the end of that interval. All parties in a ledger change action (recipients and originators) are counted. Individual addresses are not double-counted if previously active.
description.1: The sum count of unique addresses that were active in the network (either as a recipient or originator of a ledger change) in the trailing 7 days up to the end of that interval. All parties in a ledger change action (recipients and originators) are counted. Individual addresses are not double-counted if active several times in the considered interval.
description.2: The sum count of unique addresses that were active either initiating or receiving blob transactions in the network that interval. Individual addresses are not double-counted if previously active.
description.3: The sum count of unique smart contract or burn addresses that were active receiving blob transactions in the network that interval. Individual addresses are not double-counted if previously active. Burn addresses are address which contain more than 10 consecutive empty bytes in their binary representation.
description.4: The sum count of unique addresses that were active receiving blob transactions in the network that interval. Individual addresses are not double-counted if previously active.
description.5: The sum count of unique addresses that were active initiating blob transactions in the network that interval. Individual addresses are not double-counted if previously active.
description.6: The sum count of unique addresses that were active in the network (either as a recipient or originator of a ledger change) that interval. All parties in a ledger change action (recipients and originators) are counted. Individual addresses are not double-counted if previously active.
description.7: The sum count of unique smart contract addresses that were active in the network (either as a recipient or originator of a ledger change) that interval. All parties in a ledger change action (recipients and originators) are counted. Individual addresses are not double-counted if previously active.
description.8: The sum count of unique addresses that were active in the network (as a recipient of a ledger change) that interval.
description.9: The sum count of unique addresses that were active in the network (as an originator of a ledger change) that interval.
description.10: The sum count of unique addresses that were active in the network (either as a recipient or originator of a ledger change) that interval for any transfer worth more than 1 USD in native units. All parties in a ledger change action (recipients and originators) are counted. Individual addresses are not double-counted if previously active.
description.11: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least one hundred-thousandth ownership of the current supply of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than one hundred-thousandth ETH but with ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.12: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least one hundred-millionth ownership of the current supply of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than one hundred-millionth ETH but with ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.13: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least one ten-billionth ownership of the current supply of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than one ten-billionth ETH but with ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.14: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least one ten-thousandth ownership of the current supply of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than one hundred-thousandth ETH but with ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.15: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least one ten-millionth ownership of the current supply of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than one ten-millionth ETH but with ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.16: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least one one-billionth ownership of the current supply of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than one one-billionth ETH but with ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.17: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least one thousandth ownership of the current supply of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than one hundred-thousandth ETH but with ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.18: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least one one-millionth ownership of the current supply of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than one one-millionth ETH but with ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.19: The sum count of unique addresses holding any amount of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., a 0 ETH balance address with ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.20: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least 0.001 native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.21: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least 0.01 native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.22: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least 0.1 native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.23: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least 100 native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.24: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least 100,000 native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.25: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least 10 native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.26: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least 10,000 native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.27: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least 1 native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.28: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least 1,000 native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.29: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least 1,000,000 native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.30: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least one hundred dollars' worth of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.31: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least one hundred thousands dollars' worth of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.32: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least ten dollars' worth of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.33: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least ten thousands dollars' worth of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.34: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least ten million dollars' worth of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.35: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least one dollar's worth of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.36: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least one thousand dollars' worth of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.37: The sum count of unique addresses holding at least one million dollars' worth of native units as of the end of that interval. Only native units are considered (e.g., an address with less than X ETH but with more than X in ERC-20 tokens would not be considered).
description.38: The sum count of unique addresses present on the ledger at the end of that interval.
description.39: The sum count of unique addresses that were newly created with a non-zero starting balance that interval.
description.40: The sum count of unique addresses that were newly created that interval.
description.41: The count of underlying assets aggregated to compute metrics for that aggregate asset in that interval.
description.42: The last time (expressing in seconds since epoch) all metrics for that asset were fully calculated for that time and frequency.
description.43: The last time (expressing in seconds since epoch) all end-of-day metrics for that asset were fully calculated for that time.
description.44: Count of attestations (one attestation can aggregate multiple validators’ votes)
description.46: Count of validators having attested in this epoch
description.47: Count of validators having an attestation in this block
description.48: Count of validators having a late attestation in this block. A late attestation is one whose slot is not the previous slot.
description.49: The sum count of blocks created that interval that were included in the main (base) chain.
description.50: The count of blocks from the genesis (first) block to the last block of that interval on the main chain.
description.51: The mean absolute time (in seconds) between all the blocks created that interval.
description.52: The sum of the size (in bytes) of all blocks created that interval.
description.53: The mean size (in bytes) of all blocks created that day.
description.54: The sum count of uncle blocks mined in that interval.
description.55: The percentage of miner revenue derived from creating and including uncle blocks in that interval. This is equal to the sum of the uncle inclusion reward (for the main chain block miner) and the uncle rewards (for the uncle block miners) divided by the miner revenue.
description.56: The sum of native units rewarded to miners for creating and including uncle blocks in that interval. This includes the uncle inclusion reward (for the main chain block miner) and the uncle rewards (for the uncle block miners).
description.57: The sum USD value rewarded to miners for creating and including uncle blocks in that interval. This includes the uncle inclusion reward (for the main chain block miner) and the uncle rewards (for the uncle block miners).
description.58: The mean weight of all blocks created that day. Weight is a dimensionless measure of a block’s “size”. It is only applicable for chains that use SegWit (segregated witness).
description.59: The sum of the weights of all blocks created in that interval. Weight is a dimensionless measure of a block’s “size”. It is only applicable for chains that use SegWit (segregated witness).
description.60: The sum of the size (in bytes) of blob space used in that interval by the Arbitrum sequencer
description.61: The sum of the size (in bytes) of blob space used in that interval by the Base sequencer
description.62: The sum count of blobs created that interval that were included in the main chain.
description.63: The sum count of blobs, created by transactions sent to smart contracts or burn addresses, in that interval that were included in the main chain. Burn addresses are address which contain more than 10 consecutive empty bytes in their binary representation.
description.64: The sum count of data inscription blobs created that interval that were included in the main chain. Data inscription blobs are blobs created in transactions following ESIP-8
description.65: The sum of the size (in bytes) of blob space used in that interval by all tagged Layer 2 sequencers
description.66: The mean number of blobs per blob carrying transaction
description.67: The sum of the size (in bytes) of blob space used in that interval by the Optimism sequencer
description.68: The total sum of the size (in bytes) of blob space used all time up to that time interval.
description.69: The sum of the size (in bytes) of blob space used in that interval
description.70: The sum count of distinct blobs created that interval that were included in the main chain.
description.71: The sum USD value of all active native units in the last year.
description.72: The sum USD value of all native units counting the current supply and including those that will be issued over the next 10 years if the current known issuance schedule is followed.
description.73: The ratio of the sum USD value of the current supply to the sum realized USD value of the current supply.
description.74: The ratio of the free float market capitalization to the sum realized USD value of the current supply.
description.75: The ratio of the current market capitalization minus the realized market capitalization to the standard deviation of the current market capitalization.
description.76: The sum USD value of the current supply. Also referred to as network value or market capitalization.
description.77: The relative share of the total market cap for the asset in question, measured in percent.

description.896: The sum count of transactions that resulted in any ERC-20 activity in that interval. description.897: The sum count of transactions that resulted in any ERC-721 activity in that interval. Only transfers between two distinct addresses are counted. description.900: The sum count of transactions that failed to execute successfully that interval. Transactions represent a bundle of intended actions to alter the ledger initiated by a user (human or machine). A transaction is considered failed if its execution has been fully reverted.
description.901: The sum count of non-vote transactions that failed to execute successfully that interval. description.902: The sum count of vote transactions that failed to execute successfully that interval. description.903: The mean size (in bytes) per transaction for all transactions that interval.
description.904: The sum count of transactions in that interval that included at least one OP_RETURN output. OP_RETURN outputs are used to embed data into the blockchain database.
description.905: The sum count of transactions using opt-in privacy features that interval. Shielding a transaction hides some or all of the activity described by it to a blockchain observer.
description.906: The sum count of transactions using fully shielding privacy features that interval.
